chunks: The warnings came to the people of Pharaoh.
ai.seo_question: Who received the divine warnings before the people of Pharaoh?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the universality of divine justice, noting that Pharaoh’s people received multiple prophets, including Dhu'l-Nun (Jonah) in some interpretations, yet their arrogance led to their ruin. It serves as a precursor to the narrative of the Night of Decree (Laylat al-Qadr) in the same Surah, linking the historical destruction of tyrants to the ultimate triumph of the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful.
